title: Tang Poetry – Ode to the Goose
synopsis: The famous poem “Ode to the Goose” is one of the first ones taught to Chinese children.

fullText.simplified:
学唐诗—咏鹅

鹅，鹅，鹅，
曲项向天歌。
白毛浮绿水，
红掌拨清波。
    这是一首诗，诗的名字叫《咏鹅》，意思是：赞美鹅。这首诗是唐朝诗人骆宾王在7岁的时候作的诗。头一句“鹅，鹅，鹅”，写出了小诗人看到鹅时的惊喜，好像在说：“你看你看，鹅鹅鹅！”第二句“曲项向天歌”，写的是鹅叫时的样子，意思是“鹅弯曲着长长的脖子，向着蓝天高歌”。第三、四句“白毛浮绿水，红掌拨清波”写的是鹅游动的情态，意思是“鹅白色的羽毛浮动在绿水上，红色的鹅掌划动着清清的水波”。
    骆宾王用短短四句话，把鹅自由自在地在水里游动、欢叫的情景写活了，让人们在读这首诗时，也能感受到他当时的快乐、兴奋。
fullText.traditional:
學唐詩—詠鵝

鵝，鵝，鵝，
曲項向天歌。
白毛浮綠水，
紅掌撥清波。
    這是一首詩，詩的名字叫《詠鵝》，意思是：讚美鵝。這首詩是唐朝詩人駱賓王在7歲的時候作的詩。頭一句“鵝，鵝，鵝”，寫出了小詩人看到鵝時的驚喜，好像在說：“你看你看，鵝鵝鵝！”第二句“曲項向天歌”，寫的是鵝叫時的樣子，意思是“鵝彎曲著長長的脖子，向著藍天高歌”。第三、四句“白毛浮綠水，紅掌撥清波”寫的是鵝游動的情態，意思是“鵝白色的羽毛浮動在綠水上，紅色的鵝掌划動著清清的水波”。
    駱賓王用短短四句話，把鵝自由自在地在水裡游動、歡叫的情景寫活了，讓人們在讀這首詩時，也能感受到他當時的快樂、興奮。

raw.synopsis: The famous poem “Ode to the Goose” is one of the first ones taught to Chinese children.
sentence_translations: Study Tang Poetry – Ode to the Goose
You bend your neck and sing to the sky.
White feathers floating on green water,
Red-webbed feet stirring the clear ripples.
This is a poem called “Ode to the Goose”, which praises geese.
The poem was composed by Tang dynasty poet Luo Binwang when he was seven years old.
The first sentence, “Goose, goose, goose” describes how happily surprised the little poet is seeing a goose.
It’s like he is telling us: “Look! Look! A goose!”
The second sentence, “You bend your neck and sing to the sky” describes how the goose honks.
Its mening is: “the goose bends its long neck, and sings towards the blue sky”.
“White feathers floating on green water, red-webbed feet stirring the clear ripples.” describes how the goose swims.
It means “the white feathers of the goose float on the green water, while its red webs stir the clear ripples”.
In four short sentences, Luo Binwang manages to vividly describe how the goose swims and carols in the water.
It lets whoever reads the poem experience the happiness and excitement he felt at that time.
